name: Knowledge
summary: Memory and documents for your agents: a private memory area per agent, a shared company area, research notebooks.
description: Knowledge gives every connected agent its own memory area and a shared company area. Agents remember and recall through memory tools; documents keep revisions, comments and links. Memory runs on GBrain, research on Open Notebook, both inside your own deployment.

operations.title: Recall memories
operations.description: Search your memory: every area you can read (your own area and the company area), or one area. Returns ranked passages with the area and the tags of each. The owner's rules may limit results to memories with certain tags.

area.description: Area id. Omit to use your own memory area.

operations.title: Remember

steps.title: Memory engine
steps.help: Knowledge stores your documents itself and runs the memory engine beside it in your Railway project.

choices.label: GBrain
choices.note: Sourced pages and facts, hybrid search, a typed graph of people and companies.

fields.label: Add research notebooks (Open Notebook)
fields.help: Adds a research service and its database to your project.

steps.title: Model provider
steps.help: The memory engine needs an embedding model to search by meaning. Anthropic has no embeddings, so it also needs an OpenAI key.

harnessHints.instructions: Call knowledge__recall before answering questions about past work, people or decisions. Save durable facts with knowledge__remember into your own area. Cite the area of each memory you use.
